payload.title: One Message model: reader item comments become Messages in anchored threads; steering signal reads Messages; retire ReaderComment
payload.description:
Repo: **Papyrus**. Decision 3 of PPY-452419 (Ryan 2026-10-31: one Message model, decided). Reader comments on items (reader-steering `ReaderComment`, Shipped ship-d02e82 "comments as steering signals", PPY-739cb4) become `Message`s in `MessageThread`s, so the forum shows editors and readers together and there is one write path, one moderation path and one export.

## Today
- `ReaderComment` model (`amplify/data/schema.ts`, staff-only), written by `/api/reader/comment` -> `reader-actions` Lambda (`amplify/plugins/reader-steering/function/handler.py`), rendered by the `Comments` island (`papyrus-reader@1.js`, mounted by Shipped's `web/hooks.py` `_item_comments_html` ~157), moderated by `function/moderation.py` / `ai_moderation.py`, and read as a steering signal (search `ReaderComment` in the reader snapshot and Cyclotron feedback code; record the exact readers on this task before changing them).
- Messages: `Message` (`authorSub`, `authorUserProfileId`, `authorLabel`, `threadId`, `sequenceNumber`, `role`, `messageKind: "comment"`, `status`, `deletedAt`...), `MessageThread` anchored `item#<lineageId>` (threadKind `story_conversation`) or `reference#<lineageId>`; `appendConversationMessage` in `components/news-desk-taxonomy-client.ts` (console path), `postMessage` resolver (backend-enforced authorship).

## Change
1. Schema: `Message` gains `authorKind: "staff" | "reader"` (default staff) and `authorReaderId` (the reader-steering `readerId`, never the `siteSubject`); `MessageThread` gains nothing. Indexes: none new (anchor index exists). Note the Amplify build-timeout lesson for schema changes.
2. Reader write path: the reader-post task's Lambda writes `Message` + find-or-create `MessageThread` by anchor (`listMessageThreadsByAnchorAndUpdatedAt`), with `sequenceNumber` retry on clash, as `appendConversationMessage` does; move the shared logic into `src/papyrus_content/messages/conversation.py` (Python, used by the Lambda) with a TypeScript twin only where the console needs it. `/api/reader/comment` becomes an alias of `/api/reader/post` with `subject: item` for one release, then is removed.
3. Steering signal: the code that read `ReaderComment` text reads `Message` where `authorKind == "reader"` and the thread anchor is `item#...`. Same output, so Cyclotron feedback is unchanged; assert this with a fixture that produces identical signal JSON from both sources.
4. Export: `home_page/threads.py` `public_message` already omits every identity field; add `authorKind` handling for the handle lookup (unified handle task). `PUBLIC_MESSAGE_FIELDS` stays `("key","at","edited","text","author")`.
5. Backfill: `scripts/backfill-reader-comments-to-messages.py` (idempotent, keyed by the ReaderComment id in `Message.metadata.sourceReaderCommentId`), dry-run count first, run by Ryan per site. **No AWS writes by the implementer.** `ReaderComment` removal is a later PR after the backfill report.
6. Console: reader-authored Messages appear in `conversations-view.tsx` with a Lucide `users` icon and the text "reader" beside the handle (never colour alone); admins may `moderateMessage` them (soft delete, "Message removed"); readers' own edit/delete go through the reader route with the `authorReaderId` condition.

## Gherkin (`features_backend/messages-one-model.feature`)
Feature: Reader comments and newsroom threads are one Message model
  Scenario: A reader's post on an item lands in the item's conversation thread
  Scenario: An editor's reply appears in the same thread in sequence
  Scenario: The steering signal from Messages equals the signal from ReaderComment for the same text
  Scenario: A reader cannot edit or delete another reader's Message
  Scenario: An admin removes a reader's Message and the public page shows "Message removed"
  Scenario: The public export never contains authorReaderId, siteSubject, authorSub or an email

## Acceptance
- Resolver and Lambda unit tests; `features_backend` green; `docs/reader-steering.md` "Comments" rewritten to point at Messages; `docs/home-page.md` "Message threads" notes reader authors.
- Blocked by the unified handle task (author display).
